description: List output presets on the authenticated organization (GET /v1/output_preset). Returns rows with index, type id, and props. Use the index values as output indexes in adn_create_play_session (variants body field). See adn_list_output_types for the type catalog. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_list_output_presets
